known_limits: Native Linux-only runtime evidence for route/source selection, flock instance lock, and splice eligibility; Windows/arm64/darwin are cross-build compile checks only (socket_generic returns ErrUnsupportedPlatform).

Host's only non-loopback IPv4 is RFC 1918 private (ens18 192.168.6.99/24), so Assess correctly reports NO_GLOBAL_V4_SOURCE; DIRECT_V4_READY still requires a global IPv4 on the default-route interface.
FD budget unit = one accepted client socket; backend target socket is outside the unit (~2N OS FDs per N sessions plus one listener FD owned by the caller).
Backend hot update is new-sessions-only; established sessions keep their original target (no draining migration - P10 concern).
go_tcp_copy_splice_eligible is a classification; exact runtime splice/fallback byte counters intentionally not exposed (v0.8 4.4 requires ADR + benchmark first).

UDP and IPv6 tuples rejected by PortRegistry (ErrUnsupportedTuple) - P13 extends the protocol axis; half-open TCP SYN measurement not part of P09.
No idle timeout on established sessions; keepalive-bounded reclamation is a P14 candidate.
Reconcile ApplyHook/StopHook wiring of the data plane is P10's app-composition concern; P09 delivers components (Backend, Budget, tcp.Forward with Close as delete-hook primitive).
